changelog: - German label of the MARKETING stage `LEAD_QUALIFIED` is now "Bedarf geklärt" (was "Qualifiziert", read as a person's qualification). The old default stays recognised as ours (`FORMER_STAGE_LABELS` / `isOurStageLabel()`, `src/lib/programTemplates.ts`), so orgs storing it read the new label in German and "Qualified" in English, while a label a tenant typed is kept verbatim — no data change (#3907).

en: German: the sales stage "Qualifiziert" is now called "Bedarf geklärt".
tr: Almanca: "Qualifiziert" satış aşamasının adı artık "Bedarf geklärt".
